scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with exact finite-state recurrence; reproducibility via standalone SymPy checker. No general finite-support or floating-point-rate claim.
scientific_limitations: Zero-cost, reflection-symmetric two-by-three discrete martingale bridge; exact row-martingale and terminal-marginal KL projections, reference initialization; not covered by the convex-support assumptions of arXiv:2609.18850; independent validation not performed.
title: Sharp convex-order boundary slowdown in a two-by-three martingale Sinkhorn iteration
